history.summary: CSV TOWN CORRECTION: the best-supported referent is Shri Lakshmi Narayan Mandir at Link Road, Chand Purana, Moga 142038 - documented by Justdial (rated 4.5 by 7 reviewers, listed open 24 hours) and akhandapp.in (rated 5.0 by 9 reviewers, phone +91 98882 07172). Chand Purana is a village in the Bhagha Purana tehsil of Moga district, south of Moga city - NOT Moga town itself - so the town field is corrected to 'Chand Purana' (district and state remain Moga/Punjab); the CSV town 'Moga' is approximate. IDENTITY FLAG: a second candidate exists - 'Laxmi Narayan Mandir', Gill Road, Moga (place pin 30.813194, 75.181152), which lies inside Moga city and may be the intended row; treat the Chand Purana identification as provisional. No founding history or festivals are published for either shrine. No reliable temple-specific photograph was found after genuine searching, so media is empty.
